title: The Goop Paintings Pack
description: A collection of artworks for the discerning player
body:
Do you think that the vannila paintings aren't SILLY enough? This pack is for YOU!

all vannila paintings, including the unused elemental paintings, have been replaced with the swaggiest most excellent artistic depictions of whimsy.

![The Paintings ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/36be3f670e6a1fde6fc8e79e980c17ea85afc996.png)

artist credits available [here!](https://clownmodius.neocities.org/situations)
